Le lichen Belramba sert à préparer une décoction favorisant la réparation des nerfs lésés. Ses propriétés concernent les blessures nerveuses plutôt que la simple récupération de points de vie. La substance se trouve difficilement et son usage répété peut provoquer une accoutumance marquée.

This lichen is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in coniferous forests, and is best known in central Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Belramba lichen is brewed into a decoction that helps injured nerves repair themselves. Its effect concerns nerve damage rather than simple recovery of concussion hits. The substance is difficult to find and repeated use can cause substantial habituation.
